requirement:
Create `app/validators.py` with `luhn_valid(number: str) -> bool` for payment card numbers. Spaces and dashes are ignored. After cleaning, the number must be 12 to 19 digits long and satisfy the Luhn checksum (from the right, double every second digit, subtract 9 from results above 9, total divisible by 10). Anything else returns False; it must never raise. Also provide `mask_card(number: str) -> str` returning only the last 4 digits prefixed by asterisks to the original cleaned length (e.g. `************1111`), and raising `ValueError` if the number is not Luhn-valid.
The project must also contain `app/main.py` defining a FastAPI `app` (entry point `app.main:app`) (no endpoints required) and `app/__init__.py`. Include unit tests (pytest).
acceptance_criteria: Luhn checksum and length rules are enforced
Masking reveals only the last four digits and rejects invalid numbers
